title: POV: You almost sign a wallet drainer
summary: A stranger offers you a free airdrop and a claim link. We follow this fictional scam step by step, show how one signature can hand a drainer your tokens, and end with Zoo's one fix: read every signature request, and keep your savings on a wallet you never connect to claim pages.
